text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Biwa<n>Hayahide have
come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
These first three are crucial for an<n>Umamusume. As
for how she's<n>doing now that the Arima Kinen is
over...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's work on identifying my current<n>problems,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Frankly, I need more experience. The<n>senior racers
showed amazing<n>resourcefulness during races, and
considering how intuition is derived<n>from
experience...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Are you listening?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just because our first three years are<n>over doesn't
mean there won't be<n>any more races!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't exactly call this my "winning<n>equation" until I
can win every single<n>race I enter, after all. Don't
you<n>agree?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She folds her arms calmly and stares<n>at me. The
way she carries herself is<n>formidable indeed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?
choice_data_list: Let's move forward and keep winning more races!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh... That goes without saying!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I are going over<n>our plans for
future training when<n>someone approaches us...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I just came to tell you one thing. Next<n>time, I'll beat
you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And what if I don't let you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll do it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mhm. I wouldn't expect anything less<n>from you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: See you on the track.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm looking forward to racing<n>you again!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The exchange between the two<n>sisters is
awkward... but their smiles<n>sure do look alike.
